architecture.mechanism: Standardized independent verification and metering methodology prevents undetected performance degradation by establishing auditable baselines that expose discrepancies between nominal and actual equipment operation.
architecture.intervention: Install independent ultrasonic flow meters and calibrated thermal energy meters on each 1,200-ton chiller condenser loop with continuous kW/ton calculation and automated deviation alerts tied to the existing optimized water treatment program; use verified metered data to trigger early chemical cleaning before the 11% capacity drop recurs.
architecture.expected_effect: Condenser tube fouling detected within days of onset rather than after an 11% capacity and 22% efficiency decline; maintains closer-to-design condensing temperature without requiring additional shutdowns beyond the current 48-hour annual window.
architecture.falsification_test: Remove independent meters for one full cooling season and compare recorded kW/ton drift against manufacturer-provided self-reported values; if the two diverge by more than 5%, the intervention had no value over the status quo.
